authoritative_store: Private shared Kuina task hub, configured by AGENT_TASKS.md

review_batches.original_records: A subject can retain many original numeric fields, sources, intervals and representations; 100 subjects is not a 100-record limit.
review_batches.eligible_records: Only wholly saved-eligible subjects are omitted from new active work. Unique read-batch retains all original series IDs for included subjects; an eligible child does not certify siblings. Legacy read-batch keeps its existing eligible-record filtering.

assignment_requests.transport: GitHub issue created by participant using normal website link
assignment_requests.title: [Kuina claim] TASK_ID or [Kuina release] TASK_ID
assignment_requests.confirmation: Mac broker validates author and request, atomically reserves or releases in Native, and records result on issue; snapshot then reflects confirmed status
assignment_requests.release_generation: positive assignment_issue must match the current reservation origin

workflow: resume existing active or blocked work first; list your work with --include-legacy
after coordinator activation, choose your identity and an available repair-subject batch on unique.html for new work
submit the prepared GitHub issue and wait for broker confirmation
claim using your own Native agent process and stop if denied; the website never starts a worker
read-batch for exact repair subjects and all original series IDs, or the unchanged legacy catalogue section
perform bounded private context lookup for current child checks, fields and source variants
inspect existing data and metadata and reuse shared source findings
submit deduplicated source repair scope through existing v3 admission before collection
verify source feasibility and the unchanged requirements before collection
run bounded authorized work and report provenance on the same claimed task
await a matching independent eligibility audit; completing a subject batch does not certify all its fields

claims.release_allowed: own reservation only before a real worker claim exists

publication: Only roster, aggregate counts, whitelisted task statuses and GitHub assignment requests are public. Catalogue scopes, targets, paths, reports and evidence remain private.
snapshot_roster_compatibility: Legacy readers accept only the complete historical nine-person roster or the complete eleven-person roster, with every assigned participant and legacy category lead present. Unique snapshots and new legacy snapshots include all eleven participants.

unique.new_work_default: After verified coordinator activation; before activation the private wrapper preserves its legacy behavior.
unique.identity: Repair work subjects with unresolved identities retained separately; not a certified world-unique instrument total.

legacy.purpose: Resume existing assignments and reports; do not start a duplicate claim when a unique batch overlaps legacy work.
legacy.parent_jobs: retained as unassigned nonclaimable coordination records

command_interface: Arguments follow the configured private wrapper and shared-hub options. unique- task IDs route to the activated additive queue; other IDs retain legacy claim/read/report behavior.
private_context_lookup: After a successful own worker claim, read-batch returns target_id and every original series_ids member. Use those exact IDs for bounded read-only lookup in the coordinator-published private context. Inspect current child checks, source variants and original field decisions; do not scan every subject or publish context metadata.
source_admission: The wrapper handles assignment, worker claims and reports. Existing v3 source-scope propose/admit/verify remains a separate private interface described in AGENT_TASKS.md. A subject assignment does not authorize collection or make data eligible.
